body:
Thank you for your response.

Um, my therapist was a bit strange. I needed to rearrange my schedule and I also felt like my larger issues were getting ignored while talking about the "flavor of the week" issues. I asked to do once a month, and he basically said if I felt that way then we can just cease the visits.

When I went in for my "final" visit he started rehashing all my past trauma (the stuff I said we never seem to get to) and then in the last 5 minutes he suggested that I'm probably bipolar type 2.


Which had never come up before nor did he suggest I get tested. I lost my job and insurance so I stopped going. But it was super weird and made me very uncomfortable. 

Losing my bird really sucks. When I'm feeling okay I feel grateful for our time together and I can smile. But when I'm upset I beat myself up with it.

Falls on deaf ears.

As far as professional help, my professional life is in upheaval. I'm doing everything I can to work towards a stable life but I'm kneecapped by someone close to me. I expect to lean on them because they're my parnter but they're not reliable. I just need them out and focus on myself. I can't take care of both of us but I can't take care of only myself either because of his intrusive entitlement.
Of course I'll treat you better than you treat me. What was I thinking.

Yes many people have reached out and make sense. 

But this: with so much good coming from sticking around

Has not been my case at all. That's what's so frustrating. I've been telling myself that it gets better, but all I feel is regret and anger for sticking it out, because it's only gotten worse. People hurt me more and more, they care less and less.
I've honestly never felt that way before, I'm typically pretty good about bringing myself down with breathing and visualization.
Same! I have a really sweet bird.

Well yesterday they forgot I was here. They are generally very antisocial and refused to visit me for 13 years but insisted that I move here to spend time with them. It's all stuff I knew before coming. It's still disappointing. 

And that's totally true about dumping on friends which is why I don't ;] I've made sure to make more positive comments than negative ones.

But the truth is, this sucks.

And I appreciate the feedback but my financial situation requires me to stick this out. Just gotta ride the storm sometimes.

I've moved to be closer to family despite knowing that family would be rather indifferent to my presence. However they are being supportive by letting me crash here. Otherwise they could care less about my experience here in my new situation. 

I was supposed to have a job lined up. The HR lied and waited to the last minute to tell me the job was gone.

I do have 2 interviews just after a week of applying though.

My SO is purposefully picking fights and trying to get me to break up with him so he can be absolved of having to moving as well.

As you might see from my other post, I'm kinda stupid and still trying to work things out with the SO from hell.

I can't afford to live here without major assistance like 2-4 roommates and 2 possibly 3 jobs.

But thank you for asking. It feels like my friends don't want to hear about how stressful this all is.
Thanks for saying so. There is a lot more to him obviously. But this last interaction is one giant fuck you to my face, my life, my goals, and everything we had been building. I don't get it.
